candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is a composite: spontaneous spinal epidural hematoma (SSEH) as the acute space-occupying lesion causing cord compression, with vascular malformation as the underlying etiology confirmed on pathology. C001 names only the vascular malformation component, missing the hematoma itself, which is the dominant clinical and imaging finding (T1/T2 high-signal epidural lesion at T2-3 with cord compression and progressive myelopathy). The vascular malformation is a required component but not the full diagnostic object.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the underlying vascular malformation component but omits the hematoma (SSEH) which is the primary acute diagnostic entity and the composite nature of the reference diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis is a composite requiring both SSEH and vascular malformation etiology; candidates naming only one component are inherently partial
